decision: The competitor (MoneyGram Haas F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: The team failed to electronically return tyres before the start of the Qualifying
offence: Breach of Article 30.5 g) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and determined that the team had not electronically returned one set of intermediate tyres for Car 20 (Kevin Magnussen), before the start of the qualifying session, although they had physically returned the tyres to the tyre supplier. This is a technical breach of Article 30.5 (g) of the Sporting Regulations. Consistently with previous precedents for such an infringement, we fined the team €5,000.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Haas Car 20 Tyre Returns
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
